messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS 2.3.2 released: important update
messages.body_plain:
Hi All,

I have finally released an update to rNOMADS.  It's been a long time
coming.  I recommend upgrading immediately, since I put in some sanity
checks in BuildProfile() that throw a warning when you try to make a
profile outside of the model domain.  Since many people use negative
longitude and models (at least the GFS) use positive longitude, this
could potentially result in a serious problem.

The new version has been accepted onto CRAN and should be available
for download within 48 hours.

Best,

Danny
